title: HDF Evidence Package
description: Bundles references to all HDF documents for audit, authorization, and compliance review. Each content entry references a document by type, URI, and checksum for integrity verification.

packageId.description: Unique identifier for this evidence package. Optional in casual use, expected in production ATO submissions. Auto-generated if omitted during creation.

name.description: Human-readable name for this evidence package. Example: 'Enterprise Portal ATO Evidence - Q1 2026'.

description.description: Description of the evidence package's purpose and scope.

systemRef.description: URI to the hdf-system document this evidence package covers.

planRef.description: URI to the hdf-plan document that drove this assessment. Used for completeness verification — every baseline in the plan should have a corresponding results document in this package.

preparedBy.description: Identity of who prepared this evidence package.

preparedAt.description: When this evidence package was prepared. ISO 8601 format.

contents.description: References to HDF documents included in this evidence package.

completenessCheck.description: Summary of assessment completeness and compliance status.

signature.description: Digital signature covering the entire evidence package.

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for grouping and querying evidence packages.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this evidence package has not been tampered with.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this document.

Content_Type.description: The type of document referenced in the evidence package. 'bom' covers any Bill-of-Materials/manifest document (SBOM, AI model/dataset, and reserved future kinds) — its specific kind is carried by the referenced document's bomType, not by a per-kind Content_Type value.
Content_Type.title: Content Type

type.description: The type of HDF document being referenced.

uri.description: URI to the document. Can be a relative path or absolute URL.

checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum for verifying the referenced document's integrity.

description.description: Optional description of this content entry.

componentRef.description: componentId of the component this content entry relates to. Use to link SBOMs, results, or other documents to a specific system component.

Content_Reference.description: A reference to an HDF document or BOM/manifest included in the evidence package.
Content_Reference.title: Content Reference

componentsWithSbom.description: Number of system components that have an associated SBOM.

totalComponents.description: Total number of components in the system.

SBOM_Coverage.description: SBOM coverage statistics for the system.
SBOM_Coverage.$comment: This metric intentionally measures SOFTWARE (SBOM) inventory coverage only. Coverage accounting for ai-model/dataset/other BOM kinds is deliberately out of scope for now; a future generalized bomCoverage metric may be added. This is a distinct software-inventory metric, not an oversight of the Content_Type 'sbom'->'bom' generalization — do not rename or generalize it.
SBOM_Coverage.title: SBOM Coverage

allBaselinesAssessed.description: Whether all baselines referenced by system components have assessment results.

allComponentsCovered.description: Whether all system components have at least one matching target in the results.

expiredWaivers.description: Number of waivers/amendments that have expired.

unresolvedPoams.description: Number of POA&M items that are still open (not completed).

compliancePercent.description: Overall compliance percentage across all assessments.

sbomCoverage.$comment: Intentionally software-inventory (SBOM) coverage only; ai-model/dataset/other BOM kinds are out of scope for this metric for now.

Completeness_Check.description: Informational summary of assessment completeness. Not authoritative — tools should compute these from the referenced documents.
Completeness_Check.title: Completeness Check
